name: netactuate
description: Answers from NetActuate's own published data: data centers and specs, compliance by site, internet exchanges, products and pricing, marketplace apps, docs and API, each linked to its source page.

interface.longDescription:
NetActuate's server gives ChatGPT current, read-only access to the network information NetActuate publishes, so answers come from netactuate.com rather than from whatever a model half-remembers.

Ask about the global footprint and get current answers: where NetActuate has data centers and what each one publishes about power, cooling, physical security, connectivity and carrier access; which compliance certifications, such as HIPAA, SOC 2 and ISO 27001, apply at which site; where NetActuate peers across the internet exchange map; which points of presence are nearest a target market; and what NetActuate's products, solutions and published pricing say, from Media Substrate for live video to bare metal and anycast.

It also knows what runs on that network and how to build on it: the apps in NetActuate's marketplace, from partners such as Wowza and Broadpeak and open-source projects, with each listing's licensing, recommended VM size and setup guide; and NetActuate's technical docs, from cloud-init, Terraform and Ansible guides to the API reference, so "how do I create a VM through the API" gets the endpoint and the page that documents it.

Every answer links back to the netactuate.com page it comes from, so it can be checked at the source.

Every tool is read-only and needs no sign-in. It exposes only information NetActuate publishes, plus where its VPU capacity is live: no customer or account data, and no ability to provision, change or delete anything.
defaultPrompt: Which NetActuate data centers are HIPAA certified?
What is NetActuate's closest data center to Lagos, Nigeria?
What size VM does NetActuate recommend for OvenMediaEngine?

positive.description: Compliance by site: a buyer placing a regulated workload asks which sites hold a certification.
positive.prompt: Which NetActuate data centers are HIPAA certified?
positive.expected_behavior: 16 sites, each linked to its netactuate.com page.

positive.description: Nearest site to a market: a buyer asks which site is closest to where its users are.
positive.prompt: What is NetActuate's closest data center to Lagos, Nigeria?
positive.expected_behavior: Accra, Ghana first, about 400 km away, with its page link.

positive.description: Internet exchange presence: a network engineer asks where NetActuate peers.
positive.prompt: Does NetActuate peer at DE-CIX, and in which cities?
positive.expected_behavior: Yes: DE-CIX Frankfurt, Madrid and Mumbai, linked to the DE-CIX page.

positive.description: Sizing a marketplace app: a buyer asks how large a VM an app needs.
positive.prompt: What size VM does NetActuate recommend for OvenMediaEngine?
positive.expected_behavior: Minimum 2 vCPU, 4 GB RAM, 20 GB disk; recommended 8 vCPU, 16 GB RAM, 40 GB disk; linked to the setup guide.

positive.description: Building with the API: a developer asks which API call creates a virtual machine.
positive.prompt: Which NetActuate API call creates a virtual machine?
positive.expected_behavior: POST /cloud/server/buy_build and POST /cloud/server/build/:mbpkgid (API v2), each with its reference page.

negative.description: Provisioning: every tool is read-only and nothing can provision. It says it cannot create resources, and may point to the API docs or to NetActuate.
negative.prompt: Create a new virtual machine for me in Frankfurt on NetActuate.

negative.description: Account data: the plugin has no customer or account data and no sign-in. It says so and points to NetActuate's customer portal or netactuate.com/contact.
negative.prompt: Show me my NetActuate servers and my current bill.

negative.description: Unrelated: nothing to do with NetActuate, so the plugin is not called.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris today?

review.commerce_description: No commerce: the plugin answers from NetActuate's published information and sells nothing.

publication.release_notes: First submission. NetActuate's read-only server with 13 tools over netactuate.com: data centers and their published specs, compliance certifications by site, internet exchanges, nearest sites to a market, products, solutions and published pricing, the marketplace's deployable apps with sizing, and the technical docs and API reference. Every answer links to its source page. No sign-in; no customer data; nothing can be changed.
